name: Reveler of Song (Drum)

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Drum form (plays the frame drum).

traits.name: Compelled Contest
traits.summary: Can't refuse a musical contest: a Performance check with an instrument (Influence) sets the save DC; failing costs 20 Psychic and a Stun.
traits.text: The reveler can't turn down a contest of skill with Musical Instruments. As an Influence action, a creature can make a Charisma (Performance) check with a Musical Instrument; the reveler must succeed on a Charisma save with a DC equal to the check's total, or take 20 Psychic damage and be Stunned until the end of that creature's next turn.

traits.name: Dancing Step
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it leaves an enemy's reach.
traits.text: Leaving an enemy's reach never provokes Opportunity Attacks from the reveler.

traits.name: Ensemble Form (Drum)
traits.summary: This is the Drum form: it plays the frame drum.
traits.text: The reveler takes one form: Drone, Drum or Bell. The form sets some traits and actions and the instrument it plays (hurdy-gurdy, frame drum, handbells). This block is the Drum form.

actions.name: Instrumental Blast
actions.summary: +8, reach 5 ft or range 90 ft, 2d8+5 Thunder.
actions.text: A blast of thunderous music, up close or from afar: 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

actions.name: Infectious Rhythm (Drum Only)
actions.summary: Up to two creatures it sees within 30 ft: DC 16 Wis save, 4d8 Psychic (half on a success); a failure sets them dancing (Irresistible Dance, no Concentration needed).
actions.text: Wisdom save, DC 16, up to two creatures the reveler can see within 30 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target is under the Irresistible Dance spell, which needs no Concentration to keep up. Success: half damage only.

summary: A fiend who fights as a musician, blasting thunder from every direction, here with a drum whose rhythm drives two victims into a deadly dance.
